Question 349 asks about the Church's attitude toward the divorced and remarried, and this edition prints '1655-1558 1666' for it -- a range whose first number exceeds its second, so it names nothing. It cannot be repaired the way the other twenty-four malformed reference lines can, because it is not a slipped digit in this question's own line: '1655-1658 1666' is the reference line of the NEXT question (350, on the family as the domestic church), printed here in place of this one's, with a '6' fallen to a '5'. Restoring the eight-edition reading '1650-1651 1665' would replace all three numbers, which is a substitution rather than a repair; restoring only the malformed digit would give '1655-1658', a well-formed link from a question about the divorced and remarried to the paragraphs on the domestic church -- a real reference to the wrong place, which is worse than none. Per docs/decisions.md a defect with no known correct value is documented, not fixed.
